The only differences are systematic reference-designator renumbering (e.g. SKW92A as U8 vs U5, EPD FPC as J2 vs J1, boost MOSFET as Q2 vs Q1), which is a labeling/ordering convention and does not alter board behaviour, so no anomaly is reported.
